title: How do I know when a coaching session may be redeemed against a Personal Training Packages balance?
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the basis on which a coaching session may be redeemed against a package's session balance.

## Rule
A session may be redeemed against a personal-training package only while that package's own status is active. The package's status as shown on its own record is the authority for this determination; there is no other basis on which a redemption may be recorded.

## Points of judgement
- If the package's status reads active at the moment the redemption is recorded, the session may be redeemed against it.
- If the package's status reads applied, paused, exhausted, expired, or closed at that moment, the session may not be redeemed against it, since only the active status satisfies this basis.
The correlation for this determination runs from the specific package the redemption names to that same package's own status field; a redemption against one package is never decided by the status of a different package the same member happens to hold.
